question: A campaign project has finished, but the team may want to look back at its material later in the year. What is the most appropriate action?
options: A) Archive the project so it stays available for reference without sitting among the active workspaces.
B) Share the project with the whole organisation so that anyone can look back at the campaign material.
C) Strip out the instructions but keep the documents, so the project cannot produce any new answers.
D) Delete the project, since finished work should not be left in the account under any circumstances.
correct_answers: A) Archive the project so it stays available for reference without sitting among the active workspaces.
explanations: Correct. Archiving preserves the material and its context while keeping the active list clean.
Broad sharing is not a substitute for tidying up, and it widens access without a reason.
Removing the direction leaves a half-configured workspace that will mislead whoever opens it.
Deletion destroys material the team has said it may still need.
